xna-type.name: GamerCollection
xna-type.summary: Represents a collection of gamers. This collection cannot be modified and is updated automatically during the call to Update.
xna-type.syntax: public class GamerCollection<T> : ReadOnlyCollection<T>, IEnumerable<Gamer>, IEnumerable where T : Gamer
xna-type.remarks: Access this collection using the following methods. AllGamers LocalGamers RemoteGamers

method.name: GetEnumerator
method.summary: Returns a strongly typed GamerCollection.GamerCollectionEnumerator Generic Structure that can iterate through a GamerCollection.

overload.summary: Returns a strongly typed GamerCollection.GamerCollectionEnumerator Generic Structure that can iterate through a GamerCollection.
